question: Should OpenClaw expose `referenceContext` and `reference-context` as public plugin SDK surface now, make the lane explicitly experimental, or keep only a narrower internal Codex projection until cross-host semantics are designed?
rationale: The code and proof are strong enough to be a candidate implementation, but public SDK and prompt-authority semantics are maintainer product/security commitments that automation cannot bless.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

options.title: Sponsor experimental lane
options.body: Ask the contributor to mark the lane and capability experimental, document upgrade expectations, and keep the Codex projection behind that explicit contract.

options.title: Accept stable SDK lane
options.body: Proceed with this public SDK shape after maintainer security/API approval and final merge checks.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the context-engine public contract, and recent history points most strongly to jalehman on that surface.
